test_data_locations.description: Catalog validation sample read fixtures live in the default reference mount; sample manifests should use pass-through or mounted-readonly paths here instead of creating per-command staging DRAs.
Catalog validation control/read fixtures that are not in the reference bucket live in the default control-data mount; do not stage these inputs unless a row explicitly requires copied data.
Catalog validation run-directory fixtures live under the default control-data mount when copied out of raw sequencing storage for repeatable run-QC and demux tests.
